text: Importantly, while reducing DOMS potentially can benefit performance, some therapies may interfere with processes beneficial to muscle development. As noted elsewhere in this chapter, evidence shows that cold-water immersion therapy negatively affects anabolic processes (21, 72) and appears to be detrimental to long-term muscle development (72, 90). Caution should therefore be used when deciding whether to use a recovery strategy to optimize hypertrophic adaptations; the potential costs and benefits of adopting a given approach must both be taken into consideration.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
